name: io.github.wenboteng/xrechnung-validator
title: XRechnung Validator
description: Validate XRechnung XML and ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDFs with the free checkxrechnung.com API.

tools.name: validate_xrechnung
tools.description: Validate one XRechnung XML document (UBL or CII) or ZUGFeRD PDF with the official KoSIT validator. Provide exactly one of xml (the XML text) or file_base64. XML limit 5 MB. Free: 50 per IP per UTC day without a key, or 500 a month with a free API key. Files are not stored. Returns valid plus errors with rule_id and rule_url.

xml.description: XRechnung XML (UBL or CII) as text.

file_base64.description: An XML file or ZUGFeRD PDF, base64-encoded. Use this or xml.

tools.name: validate_zugferd
tools.description: Validate one ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF: PDF/A-3 basics, the embedded XML, the profile (MINIMUM, BASIC WL, BASIC, EN16931, EXTENDED, XRECHNUNG) and the EN 16931 CII Schematron. Send the PDF as file_base64 (limit 10 MB). Same free limit as validate_xrechnung (shared counter). Returns valid, profile, and errors with rule_id and rule_url.

tools.name: extract_zugferd
tools.description: Extract the embedded invoice XML and a JSON summary from a ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF. Send the PDF as file_base64 (limit 10 MB). Same free limit as validate_xrechnung (shared counter). ok means an XML attachment was found. The xml field is the raw document.
